overview:
Kamala is a west-coast area in Kathu district, between Surin and Patong. Kamala Beach, a hospital and several shops are listed in the project data; one project here is about 300 m from the beach according to its description.
The catalogue holds villas and condominiums in Kamala, including an Italian-coastal-style condominium with a shuttle to the beach and three condominiums by The Title (Rhom Bho Property): Vivana, Coralina Kamala and the newly announced Darayana Kamala, whose units, prices and completion date the developer has not yet published.
